title: SAP Analytics Cloud Weekly Active User Trend
app: SAP Analytics Cloud audit and activity exports via the SAC API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=sac:audit
| timechart span=1w dc(user) as active_users
| eventstats avg(active_users) as avg_users
| eval below_trend=if(active_users<avg_users*0.85,1,0)
description: Trends the number of distinct weekly active users of SAP Analytics Cloud and flags weeks where engagement drops below trend, an early signal of eroding adoption or an access problem.
value: Adoption is the return on a BI investment; a declining active-user trend for SAP Analytics Cloud surfaces churn before a renewal or rationalisation review.
implementation: Ingest SAP Analytics Cloud usage/activity events; schedule weekly and review adoption dips with the platform owner.
visualization: Timechart of SAP Analytics Cloud weekly active users with trend band.
grandmaExplanation: We track how many people actually use SAP Analytics Cloud each week so a drop in usage is noticed early.
